subject: Align calendars for a compact walkthrough — availability & SME nomination
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@datascape.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Align calendars for a compact walkthrough — availability & SME nomination

Hi Carlos — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: DataScape is prioritizing lower-latency inference for batch scoring and a migration path off your in-house endpoints over the next 6–9 months. You mentioned throughput peaks during ETL runs and a desire to validate cost estimates with a sample job.

Proposed next step: a focused 30‑minute product walkthrough (compact demo + ops questions). Can you confirm which of the following works for your team? I included a couple of cross-timezone options to keep it simple.

Option A: Tue Nov 9 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT (13:00–13:30 ET)
Option B: Wed Nov 10 — 8:30–9:00 AM PT (11:30–12:00 ET)
Option C: Wed Nov 10 — 3:00–3:30 PM PT (18:00–18:30 ET)

Who should be on the call from your side? You mentioned an infra/ops lead and a data-engineer — if you can confirm names I will include the right SMEs. From Redwood I'll bring Neha (solutions engineer) to run the demo and Marissa (CS) for rollout/POC questions.

I've attached a short pre-read (datascape-pre-read.pdf) and a simple security checklist to speed the ops review. If any of the above times don't work, propose two alternate slots and we'll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attach: datascape-pre-read.pdf (2 pages), rfi-security-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@datascape.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jenny Li <jenny.li@datascape.io>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Align calendars for a compact walkthrough — availability & SME nomination

Dylan — thanks for the recap and the pre-read. Quick answers:

— Option B (Wed Nov 10, 8:30–9:00 AM PT) works best for our team.
— Please include Jenny Li (Infrastructure Lead) — she’ll drive the ops questions.
— I'll also try to have our data engineer (Sahil Rao) on the call; if he can't make it we'll record and follow up.

One thing: can you flag any specific infra artifacts Neha will need to review (logs, sample payloads)? We can surface those ahead of time.

Thanks — Carlos
Carlos Mendez | Head of Data Platforms
DataScape, Inc.

Great — thanks Carlos. Wed Nov 10, 8:30–9:00 AM PT is locked. I'll send a calendar invite (link below) with the short agenda.

Pre-demo ask for your infra team (Jenny/Sahil):
- A short note on the peak batch size and a representative sample payload (json/csv) if possible
- Any network constraints (VPC peering, egress rules) we should be aware of for a POC
- If you have a preferred compliance artifact owner, send their contact so we can share the checklist answers in advance

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5 min — quick context + success criteria (Carlos)
2) 15 min — compact product walkthrough (Neha)
3) 7 min — ops Q&A (Jenny / Neha)
4) 3 min — next steps & POC checklist (Marissa)

Attachments: I've also included a draft SOW template (sow-template.docx) so you can see typical POC scope/assumptions.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.company/evt/abc123
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/DS-4392

If anything changes I can move the slot — otherwise we'll plan on Nov 10 at 8:30 PT.

Thanks — Dylan

Date: 2026-11-01T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Align calendars for a compact walkthrough — availability & SME nomination

Thanks team — I'll run the demo on Nov 10. A few notes so the call is high-value:

- Neha (pre-demo): if you can email one sample payload and a short description of the ETL cadence (how often batches run, typical record size) that will let me prepare a quick cost/latency sketch.
- During the demo I'll show: model routing & quantization choices, quick KV/prefix caching demo, and how we measure token-cost for batch scoring.
- I'll attach a 1‑page runbook after the call with the POC checklist items and required logs.

Looking forward to it. If you want a 45-min slot instead (more Q&A), I can make Nov 10 @ 9:00 PT work — let me know.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor | Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
